Report system does not work
9 Oct @ 1:04am
tuomo
The system rewards false reporting. You have to play at least 75 games to gain 2000 score on behavior/comms, while you can lose it all (at least 2000 points) at 15 games. 75 games is A LOT, and it still doesn't get you out of the dog house.
The system punishes "repeat offenders", while you can get classified as one by false reporting and sheer amount of reports that basically have no merit. When you're in the doghouse, the amount of reports to have impact must decrease (as you're the repeat offender).
